name: MCP Bridge
description: Personal fork of organicmoron/SP-MCP - bridge between Super Productivity and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for Claude Desktop integration
author: Diane Pryseski

changelog.1.3.1: Pin mcp to 1.30.0 in requirements.txt to avoid its breaking 2.0 rewrite crashing the MCP server on startup
changelog.1.3.0: Fix dashboard activity log never showing successful commands, the data-directory field, and the connection status badge getting stuck on 'Ready'
changelog.1.2.0: Note this is a personal fork of organicmoron/SP-MCP
changelog.1.1.0: Add additive add_time_spent command; fix a task-not-found handler bug, a doneOn timestamp bug, and an XSS risk in the dashboard log
changelog.1.0.0: Initial release with full MCP bridge functionality
